items.name: theme
items.title: Skeuo Theme
items.description: Soft skeuomorphic tokens: colors, radius and depth shadows (raised, pressed, primary, well, surface, chip) for light and dark, plus code surface and scrollbar tokens with thin rounded scrollbars and scrollbar-thin/-hover/-none utilities.

light.skeuo-primary: inset 0 1px 0 0 rgb(255 255 255 / 0.3), inset 0 -1px 0 0 rgb(0 0 0 / 0.12), 0 0 0 1px color-mix(in oklch, var(--primary), black 18%), 0 1px 2px rgb(15 18 25 / 0.2), 0 4px 10px -4px color-mix(in oklch, var(--primary) 70%, transparent)

dark.skeuo-primary: inset 0 1px 0 0 rgb(255 255 255 / 0.28), inset 0 -1px 0 0 rgb(0 0 0 / 0.15), 0 0 0 1px color-mix(in oklch, var(--primary), black 25%), 0 1px 2px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.4), 0 4px 12px -4px color-mix(in oklch, var(--primary) 55%, transparent)

items.name: icons
items.title: Icons
items.description: Puffy, soft single-color icon set on an 18x18 grid. Filled shapes use a 1.5px round-join stroke, open glyphs a 1.6px round stroke.

items.name: button
items.title: Button
items.description: Pill button with raised, pressed and primary depth.

items.name: badge
items.title: Badge
items.description: Chips and status badges, with an optional avatar mark.

items.name: card
items.title: Card
items.description: Raised surface card with header, content and footer parts.

items.name: input
items.title: Input
items.description: Text input in a soft inset well.

items.name: textarea
items.title: Textarea
items.description: Auto-growing textarea in a soft inset well.

items.name: label
items.title: Label
items.description: Form label.

items.name: checkbox
items.title: Checkbox
items.description: Inset-well checkbox that fills primary and draws its check on, with an indeterminate dash and a springy press.

items.name: radio
items.title: Radio
items.description: RadioGroup and Radio with inset wells and a raised primary dot that glides to the selected option.

items.name: stepper
items.title: Stepper
items.description: Numeric − value + stepper on Base UI NumberField with rolling digits, raised buttons and disabled ends at min and max.

items.name: slider
items.title: Slider
items.description: Single or range slider with an inset well track, primary fill, raised thumb, optional tick dots and a floating value bubble.

items.name: popover
items.title: Popover
items.description: Floating panel that scales out of its trigger, with optional header, title, description, footer and close parts.

items.name: context-menu
items.title: Context Menu
items.description: Right-click or long-press menu that grows from the pointer, sharing the Menu's items, checkboxes, radios and submenus.

items.name: drawer
items.title: Drawer
items.description: Side panel that springs in from the left or right over a blurred backdrop, with header, body and footer parts.

items.name: bottom-sheet
items.title: Bottom Sheet
items.description: Draggable bottom sheet with snap points, fling-aware drag-to-dismiss and a grip handle that also cycles snaps from the keyboard.

items.name: alert
items.title: Alert
items.description: Composable inline alert (Alert, AlertIcon, AlertContent, AlertTitle, AlertDescription, AlertAction, AlertClose) with info/success/warning/destructive variants and animated appear/dismiss.

items.name: collapsible
items.title: Collapsible
items.description: Base UI Collapsible with a smooth height reveal, soft content fade and a rotating chevron trigger.

items.name: accordion
items.title: Accordion
items.description: Base UI Accordion in an inset well with raised open rows, optional icon chips, springy height reveal and single or multiple open items.

items.name: breadcrumb
items.title: Breadcrumb
items.description: Composable breadcrumb parts with separators, a raised current-page chip, soft crumb entrances and an ellipsis that opens a menu of hidden crumbs.

items.name: dock
items.title: Dock
items.description: macOS-style dock of icon buttons with hover magnification, groups and separators, a gliding active pill and tooltips.

items.name: text-reveal
items.title: Text Reveal
items.description: Word- or character-by-character reveal with a springy slide-up and blur, on mount or when scrolled into view.

items.name: text-shimmer
items.title: Text Shimmer
items.description: CSS-only highlight that sweeps across text in theme token colours.

items.name: text-scramble
items.title: Text Scramble
items.description: Controlled text that scrambles through random glyphs before resolving to its new value, at a stable width.

items.name: number-ticker
items.title: Number Ticker
items.description: Slot-machine digits that roll to a new value with a staggered spring, formatted with Intl.NumberFormat.

items.name: animated-number
items.title: Animated Number
items.description: Number that springs up to its value when it scrolls into view, formatted with Intl.NumberFormat.

items.name: marquee
items.title: Marquee
items.description: Infinite horizontal or vertical scroller with edge fade and pause on hover, driven by CSS animation.

items.name: combobox
items.title: Combobox
items.description: Searchable select with grouped options, empty state and keyboard navigation, in an inset pill input with a select-style popup.

items.name: color-selector
items.title: Color Selector
items.description: Row of colour swatches as an accessible radio group, with a selection ring that glides between them on a spring.

items.name: loader
items.title: Loader
items.description: Loading indicator in eight variants (spinner, ring, dots, bars, pulse, ripple, orbit, typing) and three sizes that inherits currentColor and fades calmly under reduced motion.

items.name: multi-select
items.title: Multi Select
items.description: Searchable multiple-choice combobox with removable chips that spring in and out of the trigger and checkbox-style ticks.

items.name: button-stateful
items.title: Button Stateful
items.description: Our Button that moves idle → loading → success / error, blur-swapping its icon and label while its width springs to fit each state.

items.name: magnetic
items.title: Magnetic
items.description: Wrapper that pulls any element toward a nearby cursor and springs it home on leave, for fine pointers only and off under reduced motion.

items.name: button-magnetic
items.title: Button Magnetic
items.description: Our Button wrapped in Magnetic, with the label leaning slightly further than the surface for a layered pull.

items.name: button-metallic
items.title: Button Metallic
items.description: Neutral card-coloured button framed by a drifting chrome rim mixed from theme tokens, with a reflection that travels across it on a loop and on hover.

items.name: hold-action-button
items.title: Hold Action Button
items.description: Press-and-hold confirm button whose wavy liquid fill rises vertically or horizontally, drains if released early, and works with a held Space or Enter.

items.name: slide-action-button
items.title: Slide Action Button
items.description: Inset track with a draggable thumb that confirms when slid to the end (with an optional pending state for async work) and springs back otherwise; keyboard-operable as a slider.

items.name: expanding-arrow-button
items.title: Expanding Arrow Button
items.description: Raised pill with an accent tile that sweeps across the button into a fading trail of dotted chevrons on hover or keyboard focus.

items.name: expandable-control
items.title: Expandable Control
items.description: Click-to-expand controls: an icon button that grows to reveal its label and a chip that reveals a trailing action, both morphing width on a spring.

items.name: text-cascade
items.title: Text Cascade
items.description: Standalone text that rolls letter by letter, left to right, through a soft blur whenever its value changes, gliding to the new width.

items.name: action-swap-blur
items.title: Action Swap Blur
items.description: Copy-button style control whose label and icon dissolve into the next state with blur, fade and scale, with optional auto-reset.

items.name: action-swap-roll
items.title: Action Swap Roll
items.description: Button whose next label and icon roll up from below through a soft blur as the old ones lift away.

items.name: action-swap-cascade
items.title: Action Swap Cascade
items.description: Button whose label swaps with a letter-by-letter slot roll between states while the icon rolls as one piece.

items.name: digit-swap
items.title: Digit Swap
items.description: Fixed-slot digits and mask glyphs that roll only where they change, with auto/up/down direction and stagger from either end.

items.name: chromatic-text-reveal
items.title: Chromatic Text Reveal
items.description: Fixed prefix with a cycling final word that sweeps in while its split red, green and blue channels converge into the text colour.

items.name: animated-badge
items.title: Animated Badge
items.description: Status badge on our badge look whose glyph and label roll between idle, loading, success, warning, error and info, with an optional ping pulse and three sizes.

items.name: select-morph
items.title: Select Morph
items.description: Select whose pill trigger unfolds into the option list as one surface, folding back on close, built on Base UI Select.

items.name: popover-morph
items.title: Popover Morph
items.description: Popover whose panel grows out of the trigger's own shape and colour and folds back into it, built on Base UI Popover.

items.name: morphing-modal
items.title: Morphing Modal
items.description: Single dialog surface with inner views that springs to each view's height as you navigate, with direction-aware transitions and back navigation.

items.name: center-morph-modal
items.title: Center Morph Modal
items.description: Modal whose surface unfolds from a small seed at its centre out to its edges, with content settling in behind, built on Base UI Dialog.

items.name: shared-layout-bg
items.title: Shared Layout Background
items.description: Raised hover pill that glides between items via shared layout, follows keyboard focus, and blurs in and out as the pointer enters and leaves the group.

items.name: aspect-ratio
items.title: Aspect Ratio
items.description: Responsive frame locked to a ratio that springs smoothly between ratios, with a cover-cropped image part that scales without stretching.

items.name: tilt-card
items.title: Tilt Card
items.description: Card that tilts toward the cursor in 3D with a pointer-tracked glare and optional parallax layers, switched off for touch and reduced motion.

items.name: wheel-picker
items.title: Wheel Picker
items.description: iOS-style picker wheel: a 3D drum driven by a real scroll container, so it gets native momentum and scroll-snap detents, plus mouse drag and full keyboard control; compose several in a WheelPickerGroup for times and dates.

items.name: arc-picker
items.title: Arc Picker
items.description: Radial text picker whose labels ride a curve bowed toward the top, bottom, left or right, moved by wheel, drag with momentum or arrow keys, with a well pill that stretches to the selected label.

items.name: color-picker
items.title: Color Picker
items.description: Composable colour picker whose raised trigger chip morphs open into a saturation/brightness area with hue and opacity sliders, a hex field and presets.

items.name: date-range-picker
items.title: Date Range Picker
items.description: Composable date range picker (Root, Trigger, Content, Calendar, Grid, Presets, Summary, Clear) with animated month navigation, hover range preview and keyboard grid navigation, built on Intl and Date with no date library.

items.name: sortable-stack
items.title: Sortable Stack
items.description: Drag-to-reorder stack of raised rows on motion Reorder, dragged from a grip handle, with keyboard reordering, screen-reader announcements and a one-step undo.

items.name: range-slider-inline
items.title: Range Slider Inline
items.description: Base UI slider with a raised fill growing inside an inset well, the label and value printed on the track, ten stop markers and a slim thumb that parts around the text.

items.name: range-slider-fluid
items.title: Range Slider Fluid
items.description: Thumbless Base UI slider pill whose primary fill glides behind a rounded liquid cap while the label flips colour wherever the fill covers it.

items.name: range-slider-wave
items.title: Range Slider Wave
items.description: Equalizer-style Base UI slider whose bars rise into a springy crest around the handle and fall back as it passes.

items.name: range-slider-bubble
items.title: Range Slider Bubble
items.description: Base UI slider whose value bubble pops out of the thumb on grab or keyboard focus, leaning and squashing with drag velocity before settling upright.

items.name: range-slider-ruler
items.title: Range Slider Ruler
items.description: Ruler slider with a fixed needle and a scale that scrolls underneath, coasting on a flick and snapping to the nearest tick, with full keyboard support.

items.name: pull-to-refresh
items.title: Pull to Refresh
items.description: Scroll container with rubber-band pull, a threshold arrow that winds up and turns primary, async onRefresh and our loader while it runs.

items.name: smooth-scroll
items.title: Smooth Scroll
items.description: Lenis-powered SmoothScroll provider that eases the window or its own scroll container, with a useSmoothScroll hook exposing offset, progress, velocity and scrollTo.

items.name: scroll-progress
items.title: Scroll Progress
items.description: Scroll-driven progress indicator as an edge bar (fixed, sticky or absolute) or a raised ring with an optional percentage, spring-smoothed and exposed as a progressbar.

items.name: parallax
items.title: Parallax
items.description: Wrapper that drifts its children at a speed factor while they cross the viewport, in the window or any scroll container, resting in place when centred.

items.name: scroll-to
items.title: Scroll To
items.description: Button that eases to a px offset, selector or element through the nearest SmoothScroll, falling back to native smooth scrolling, and can move focus to the target.

items.name: scroll-reveal
items.title: Scroll Reveal
items.description: Reveals content with a spring slide and blur as it enters view, from any side, once or every time it re-enters.

items.name: cylinder-carousel
items.title: Cylinder Carousel
items.description: Looping 3D carousel that lays items on the inside wall of a cylinder, rolled by drag with flick momentum, horizontal wheel, arrow keys or buttons, snapping on a spring.

items.name: morphing-lightbox
items.title: Morphing Lightbox
items.description: Thumbnail grid whose images morph out of their thumbnails into a full viewer and back, with gallery navigation, swipe, keyboard control and captions.

items.name: shader-background
items.title: Shader Background
items.description: Animated WebGL background in mesh-gradient, grain, warp, waves and dot-orbit variants, coloured from props or theme tokens and paused offscreen or under reduced motion.

items.name: recommendation-card
items.title: Recommendation Card
items.description: Agent suggestion with inline chips, a confidence meter and accept/alternatives actions.

items.name: switch
items.title: Switch
items.description: Toggle with a springy raised thumb in an inset track.

items.name: tabs
items.title: Tabs
items.description: Segmented pill tabs with a sliding raised indicator.

items.name: dialog
items.title: Dialog
items.description: Modal with soft scale-in, blurred backdrop and close button.

items.name: menu
items.title: Menu
items.description: Dropdown menu with raised highlight, checkbox and radio items, submenus and shortcuts.

items.name: tooltip
items.title: Tooltip
items.description: Pill tooltip with scale-in motion and an optional keyboard hint.

items.name: select
items.title: Select
items.description: Pill select that aligns the chosen item with the trigger, with groups and check indicator.

items.name: toast
items.title: Toast
items.description: Stacked, swipeable toasts with typed icons, actions and promise-style updates.

items.name: prompt-bar
items.title: Prompt Bar
items.description: Auto-growing prompt input with attach, voice, and an animated send/stop button.

items.name: chat
items.title: Chat
items.description: Chat thread with spring-in bubbles and a typing indicator.

items.name: approval-card
items.title: Approval Card
items.description: Approve or decline an agent action, with animated result and undo.

items.name: task-row
items.title: Task Row
items.description: Background task row with animated status marks (queued, running, done, failed).

items.name: otp-input
items.title: OTP Input
items.description: One-time-code field on Base UI OTPField with a gliding focus ring, digits that roll in, paste and autofill support, an error shake and a success check.

items.name: command-palette
items.title: Command Palette
items.description: ⌘K palette with fuzzy search, grouped results, a gliding active row, keyboard navigation and shortcut hints.
